page.title: Bank reconciliation
page.subtitle: Bank statement lines matched to the ledger

summary.toReconcileNotOnStatement: {open} of {lines} bank lines to reconcile · {count, plural, one {# app entry} other {# app entries}} not on the statement
summary.drafts: {count, plural, one {# draft entry} other {# draft entries}} not counted in the app balance until reviewed

import.title: Import a bank statement

check.matches: Opening {opening} + in {inflows} − out {outflows} = {expected} — matches the closing balance ✓
check.off: Opening {opening} + in {inflows} − out {outflows} = {expected} — closing is {closing}, off by {diff}
check.incomplete: Opening {opening} + in {inflows} − out {outflows} = {expected} — enter both balances

import.submit: {count, plural, one {Import # new line} other {Import # new lines}}
import.done: {added, plural, one {Imported # new line.} other {Imported # new lines.}}
import.doneSkipped: {added, plural, one {Imported # new line} other {Imported # new lines}} · {skipped} already imported, skipped.

toast.title: Statement imported
toast.added: {added, plural, one {# new line added} other {# new lines added}}
toast.addedSkipped: {added, plural, one {# new line added} other {# new lines added}}, {skipped} skipped

match.title: Match bank line — {amount} on {date}
match.help: Pick the ledger entries on {account} that make up this line — several if it covers more than one. Transfers, capital and loans are recorded on the Accounts page first.
match.selectedOver: Selected {total} of {remaining} still open<over> — more than the line</over>
match.submit: {count, plural, =0 {Match entries} one {Match # entry} other {Match # entries}}

toast.linked: {count, plural, one {# entry linked} other {# entries linked}}

imports.title: Imported statements
imports.description: Each file was accepted only because opening + money in − money out equals its closing balance.
imports.confirmUndo: Remove this import and its {count} lines?

lines.newEntry: New income/expense entry from this line
lines.empty: No statement lines yet — import a statement to start.
lines.allMatched: Every bank line is matched to the ledger.

notOnStatement.title: In the app but not on the bank statement
notOnStatement.description: Entries on a bank account, inside the statement period, that no bank line explains — check the account and date, or match them above.

statement.unreadable: This file couldn't be read — export the statement as Excel (.xlsx) or CSV.
statement.noTable: No transaction table found — the file needs a header row with a date column and debit/credit (or amount) columns.

warnings.order: The running balance doesn't follow the line order everywhere — check the totals above against the bank.
warnings.opening: The stated opening balance differs from the running balance.
warnings.closing: The stated closing balance differs from the running balance.

errors.chooseAccount: Choose which account this statement is for.
errors.wrongCurrency: This statement is in {statementCurrency}, but {account} is a {accountCurrency} account.
errors.enterBalances: Enter the statement's opening and closing balance.
errors.doesNotAddUp: The statement doesn't add up: opening {opening} + in {inflows} − out {outflows} = {expected}, but the closing balance is {closing}. Nothing was imported.
errors.chooseEntry: Choose at least one ledger entry.
errors.entryGone: An entry no longer exists — refresh the page.
errors.reversed: A reversed entry can't be matched — match its correction instead.
errors.alreadyMatched: "{name}" is already matched to another bank line.
errors.alreadyMatchedUnnamed: "That entry" is already matched to another bank line.
errors.postedUnmatch: That entry is posted — only the owner can unmatch it.
errors.statementMatched: Some of its lines are matched to ledger entries — unmatch them first.
errors.statementOverlaps: Another imported statement overlaps this period — undo that one first.
errors.lineGone: That bank line no longer exists.
errors.otherAccount: The bank line is on {account} — the entry must be too.
errors.lineInEntryOut: The bank line is money in; this entry is money out.
errors.lineOutEntryIn: The bank line is money out; this entry is money in.
errors.moreThanLine: That's more than the bank line ({amount}).
